nodes.name: Called by another workflow
nodes.notes: Targeted knowledge retrieval, for the tenants whose corpus has outgrown being sent wholesale by the Business Loader. Most tenants never need this.

nodes.name: Trigram search
nodes.notes:
Ranked by trigram similarity against the GIN indexes on title and content. No embedding pipeline and no vector spend — a good fit for FAQ matching, where the question and the stored question share vocabulary.

The metacharacter strip is load-bearing: an unescaped comma in a customer message would break out of the `or` filter list, which is a filter-injection bug rather than merely a bad result.

needs_review=false keeps unapproved scrape output out of prompts.

meta.description: Keyword knowledge retrieval for large corpora. The schema also carries a pgvector embedding column and an IVFFlat index for tenants who outgrow trigram matching.
